summary: Bureau of Land Management lookout on Bennett Mountain, Elmore County: a cabin from 1937, later two-story cabs; destroyed in 2016; closed to visitors.

facts.design: Two-story cab; the 1964 cab was concrete
facts.status_note: Destroyed in 2016; no source describes what remains at the site.

access.note: firelookout.com says No public access; a 2019 climbing-guide check found the jeep roads closed to the public.

events.note: Two-story metal and frame cab, 12 by 12 feet
Vern Boren is the first staff member named
David McCoy, the last staff member named in the sources
Lookout evacuated and secured during the Elk Fire Complex

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com's heading reads R.I.P. 1963-2016, but its own history starts with a 1937 cabin and dates the concrete cab to 1964. The story uses the dated entries.
One listing says destroyed in 2016 and another says demolished. The story gives 2016 and reports both words; no source gives a cause.
Drive-up is a roadside classification in the Idaho listing. firelookout.com says there is no public access and the climbing guide reports closed roads, so the story says the site is not open.

notes_for_editor: Construction and staffing dates agree across sources, but several come from one Idaho lookouts page and its Kresek-based inventory. The 2013 evacuation comes from one source (idaholookouts.weebly.com). Access wording rests on firelookout.com plus a 2019 climbing-guide recon, not a current agency notice; the story says so only by quoting them. The record's access 'unknown' could be updated to closed by a human. No record corrections proposed. The 1963 date in firelookout.com's heading is unexplained.
